sentences.text: **Scheme Brief Description:** Ladli Lakshmi Yojana has been started in Madhya Pradesh for Girl Child in 2007.
**Who is this for:** Individual; Category: Social welfare & Empowerment; Sector: Financial assistance

**Detailed Description:** Ladli Lakshmi Yojana has been implemented in Madhya Pradesh with the objective of creating positive thinking in public towards the birth of girl child, improvement in sex ratio, improvement in educational level, health condition of girls and laying the foundation stone for their good future.  Some families are financially weak and not able to give higher education to their daughters nor can they collect money for their marriage. The State government has started the Ladli Laxmi Yojana to provide financial assistance for the education and marriage of the daughter. This money can be used by the girl for her higher education or marriage and to promote the empowerment of women in the state.

**Benefits / Assistance:** 1. An assurance certificate of ₹1,43,000/- is issued by the government in the name of the girl child. 1. From the time of registration, ₹6,000/- will be deposited in the **Madhya Pradesh Ladli Laxmi Yojana Fund** for five consecutive years, the total amount of ₹30,000/- will be deposited in the name of the girl child. 1. To girl child taking admission in class 6th: ₹2,000/- 1. To girl child taking admission in class 9th: ₹4,000/- 1. To girl child taking admission in class 11th: ₹6,000/- 1. To girl child taking admission in class 12th: ₹6,000/- 1. An incentive amount of ₹25,000/- in two equal installments in the first and last year of the course after taking admission to a graduate or professional course (course duration minimum two years) after class 12th. 1. Final payment of ₹1,00,000/- on completion of 21 years of age of the girl child, on appearing in class 12th examination and on the marriage of the girl child, after completing the age prescribed by the government.

**Application Process:** 1. Applicants have to visit the [official portal](https://ladlilaxmi.mp.gov.in/llyhome.aspx).1. Click on "[Apply Now](https://ladlilaxmi.mp.gov.in/Application/Public/Rules.aspx)".1. Provide the "Self Declaration" and click on Proceed. 1. Enter the required Samagra ID of the Girl and family. 1. Provide the required details related to the Girl and her family 1. Submit.
**Contacts & Authorities:** Nodal Department: Women and Child Development Department
**Tags:** Financial Assistance, Empowerment, Social Welfare, Girl Child
